summary: Defines an experimental change to TLS to support the certificate types specified by IEEE and ETSI, used by Intelligent Transport Systems such as connected vehicles, to authenticate TLS entities.

eli5.summary: Cars and roadside gear have their own kinds of ID cards. This document teaches the secure-connection system to understand those cards so such devices can prove who they are.

questions: how to use vehicle certificates in tls
what are ieee etsi certificates in tls
